answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a history of useful, attested work. Like a zephyr that fades, the stake value decays unless the agent keeps doing real jobs peers can verify; a fake army must fund each ember of identity separately, and one exposed sockpuppet burns its whole stake. Reputation then flows like an ocean current, costly to fake at scale and cheap to keep for honest agents, because attackers pay per identity while honest agents pay once and earn it back.
